title: Iron Will
wikitext:
{{About|the keystone passive skill|the support gem|Iron Will Support}}

{{Passive skill box|Iron Will}}

'''Iron Will''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that causes the increased [[melee]] [[physical damage|physical]] [[attack]] damage bonus from [[strength]] to apply to [[spell]]s as well.

==Mechanics==
Iron Will causes strength to grant 1% increased spell damage per 5 points of strength, alongside the melee physical damage bonus it already grants. Note that this bonus applies to all spell damage, not just physical.

{{c|mod|Iron Will}} is a keyword and will not stack with other sources of {{c|mod|Iron Will}}, such as {{il|Iron Will Support}} and {{il|Repentance}}.

Effects that modify strength's effect on melee physical damage will also affect the bonus to spell damage granted by Iron Will. For example, {{il|The Iron Fortress}} grants {{c|mod|Strength's Damage Bonus instead grants 3% increased Melee Physical Damage per 10 Strength}}; this will also apply to the increase in spell damage granted by Iron Will. Another notable interaction is with {{il|Crown of Eyes}} which grants {{c|mod|Increases and Reductions to Spell Damage also apply to Attacks at 150% of their value}}, this in conjunction with Iron Will means that every 10 points of strength gives 3% increased attack damage, and if used alongside {{il|The Iron Fortress}} this becomes 4.5% increased attack damage per 10 strength. This increased attack damage does not stack with the original 2% increased Melee Physical Damage per 10 strength, only the higher modifier is applied.

==Location==
Iron Will is located in the center of the passive skill tree, west of the [[Scion]] starting area.
